pages.text: A bush found in forests and birch forests. It grows like a sweet berry bush and is picked the same way, though it has no thorns.$(br2)Amorberries are not for eating. Dragons find them irresistible.

pages.title: Amorberry
pages.text: Plant a berry to grow a new bush. Ripe bushes are picked by right-clicking and regrow their fruit in time.
